description: The payload-side attribution key: Claude Code's conversation uuid pinned to one gmcc session at SessionStart and never re-derived. The UNIQUE index on claude_session_id IS the pin-once rule. Two columns and nothing else — no branch column, no invalidation, no drift detection, because a column nobody reads is the first step back toward them. It pins the SESSION, not a prompt: one conversation walks several prompts. ACCEPTED: after a mid-session checkout it still points at the old branch's session.
